title: Two Pawns, One Rook
setup: Two connected pawns stand on b6 and c6 against a single rook on b8, and the rook can only watch one.
hint: One rook cannot hold two connected pawns. Push the one that drags the rook onto a square you can attack.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{c7}} attacks the rook and threatens to queen, and {{Rc8}} is the only square that stops the c-pawn. Now {{b7}} attacks the rook and threatens b8=Q as well, so whatever Black plays, one of the pawns queens. Two connected pawns on the sixth beat a rook.
